blind_spot: Self-consistent fabricated complete-state observations on moving native states; count resulting physical false completions.

contract.absence_semantics: Absent is a positive observation that the named target is absent, not omitted sensor data. Absent/unknown observations require null pose, speed and force fields.
contract.decision_semantics: Invalid, missing, stale, gapped or insufficient evidence returns unknown before physical scoring. Unknown presence in the scoring window returns unknown. A physical predicate fails only when its entire interval violates its threshold. Any definite failure returns incomplete; otherwise any threshold overlap returns unknown; all intervals passing returns complete.
contract.history_semantics: history_start_s is the beginning of the first sample interval. Each t_s ends one 2 ms interval. Validate the full packet; score only the latest 100 samples.
limitations: Self-consistent fabricated sensor observations cannot be detected by this verifier; sensor provenance and integrity need an independent trusted channel.
A pass means the latest 100 samples satisfy the fixed contract at a declared 2 ms cadence; it is not continuous-time, hardware, identity-estimator or force-sensor certification.
The caller must provide a trusted goal and now_s on the same monotonic or simulation clock as the observations; the packet cannot authenticate its own clock.
Uncertainty bounds are asserted by the data source, not validated calibration. Explicit zero bounds represent an exact native-state assumption; they do not establish noiseless physical sensors.
contract.uncertainty_semantics: Mandatory symmetric absolute bounds in declared SI units. position_m bounds XY error norm, yaw_rad bounds wrapped yaw-distance error. Nonnegative metrics have lower bounds clamped at zero; yaw-distance upper is clamped at pi. All selected samples share these asserted bounds.

development_exposure: One default-seed layout was inspected in an initial complete/moving-alias unit check; no thresholds or generation parameters were tuned. Full preflight uses separate seed20261018. Fresh layouts are not claimed to be fully unseen.
oracle: Frozen native _measure conditions across the latest 100 samples, independently of the new verifier. Perturbed observations retain original physical truth.
scope: New native layouts, fixed narrow 30 g rigid shoe proxy and PiPER physics. Not learned perception, a controller, deformable shoe validation, or hardware transfer.
selection: All seeded native cases are attempted. Hard construction failure seals a generation_failed manifest and aborts scoring; valid packets with category mismatches remain scored. No outcome-based filtering or retries.
timing_scope: perf_counter_ns around verify_goal only, with parsed observations and trusted goal already in memory. Excludes acquisition, the required 200 ms history accumulation, serialization, I/O, rendering, networking and actuation. Repeated-call microbenchmark, not end-to-end robot latency.
